author: ROYCE MCCANDLESS rmccandless@idahopress.com
title: ISP facing recruitment shortage in north Idaho - NewsBreak
text:
By ROYCE MCCANDLESS rmccandless@idahopress.com ,
7 hours ago BOISE — The Idaho State Police announced the agency is facing an ongoing shortage of troopers in north Idaho that could worsen due to a limited pool of applicants. A release issued this past weekend detailed just a month remained before applications close for the Idaho State Police trooper academy in January. At present, only seven applicants in the Coeur d’Alene region, and three in the Lewiston region, are meeting current minimum requirements, numbers that are expected to decline further as the hiring process advances. Read full article
